text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've arrived at the final race of the Tiara tour, the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The media is abuzz with talk of Narita Brian and the upcoming Triple Crown finale. Hishi Amazon is reminded once more of her rival's power, and gets fired up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she sets off to race, she discovers a letter and a gift from her dorm residents, whose support boosts her motivation even more.
